TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In view of Hanuman Janmotsav at Marghat Wale Baba Hanuman Mandir on 01.04.2026 & 02.04.2026, traffic may be affected in the nearby stretches.

Timings:
-01 April: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM
-02 April: Entire day

📍 Diversions may apply at:
Rail Chhatta Chowk, Subhash Cut, GPO Chowk, Kela Ghat, Iron Bridge, Boulevard Rd–Lothian Rd T-Point, Ring Road (Monkey Bridge)

📍 Avoid affected stretches,plan routes in advance, especially for ISBT & Old Delhi Railway Station

📍 Prefer public transport like Metro & buses

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

#HYDTPinfo
🚦 #TrafficAlert

Due to heavy traffic flow, vehicle movement is slow from Ayodhya Junction towards VV Statue.

Commuters are advised to plan accordingly and take alternate routes to avoid delays.

 ●Erratic Weather to continue till 10th April .

●7-9th April:Fresh spells of light to moderate rain/snow (higher reaches)/thunder/gusty winds at many places.
